description: Use when the user asks for AI agents or tools for a compliance, GRC or security task, or by framework. Returns the main GRC directory by default, with named agent-security products in a separate group. Pass segment=agent-security for that catalog only, or segment=all for both. Canonical theagentindex.io URLs. Not a ranking.

category.description: Agent category slug (compliance, security, risk, privacy, business-ops, code-security, or security-catalog slugs agent-identity, agent-governance, agent-runtime-security, agent-secrets, guardrails-prompt-injection, mcp-gateways-scanners, ai-red-teaming)

framework.description: Compliance framework filter, e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA

pricing_model.description: Pricing model filter, e.g. annual-contract, usage, quote

query.description: Free-text query over name, vendor, summary, description, categories and frameworks

segment.description: Catalog segment. Omit for the main GRC directory. "agent-security" for tools that secure or govern AI agents. "all" searches both. Default excludes the security catalog.

name: search_agents
title: Search GRC AI agents
